title: Vectorized Dynamic Histograms for Sparse Oblique Forests
abstract: arXiv:2603.00326v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sparse oblique (SPO), part of the top-ranked configuration of Google's Yggdrasil Decision Forests (YDF), improve the accuracy while maintaining interpretability of Random Forests (RF) and Gradient Boosted Trees (GBT) by scanning a sparse linear combination of features instead of a single feature. Because projections are sampled at runtime, training is significantly slower, as pre-run optimizations such as presorting cannot be used. We overhaul SPO training in YDF, first by fixing inefficiencies in the released version, achieving 2-5x speedup, then by devising two novel methods, one aimed at GBTs and the other at RFs: (1) Hierarchical AVX2 and AVX-512-vectorized histogram filling speeds up typical GBT-depth trees by up to 1.6x in SPO-GBT and 2x for SPO-RF, and (2) runtime-dynamic histograms between vectorized histograms and exact splits, speeds up deeper, RF depth-typical trees (depths 16 to purity) by up to 1.6x with no detectable ef

translated_title: 面向稀疏斜森林的向量化动态直方图
translated_abstract: 稀疏斜树是Google的Yggdrasil决策森林（YDF）排名最高配置的一部分，它通过扫描特征的稀疏线性组合而非单个特征，在保持随机森林（RF）和梯度提升树（GBT）可解释性的同时提升了准确性。由于投影需要在运行时采样，无法使用预排序等运行前优化，训练速度因此显著变慢。我们对YDF中的SPO训练进行了全面改进：首先修复了已发布版本中的低效问题，实现了2-5倍的加速；随后提出了两种新方法，分别针对GBT和RF：（1）分层的AVX2和AVX-512向量化直方图填充，对典型GBT深度的树，在SPO-GBT中可将速度提升至多1.6倍，在SPO-RF中提升至多2倍；（2）介于向量化直方图与精确分裂之间的运行时动态直方图，对更深的典型RF深度树（深度16直至纯度）可将速度提升至多1.6倍，且未检测到效率或准确性上的损失。
tldr: 本文通过修复已有低效问题并提出分层向量化直方图填充与运行时动态直方图两项新方法，将Google YDF中稀疏斜森林的训练速度最高提升至原来的数倍。
en_tdlr: This paper accelerates Sparse Oblique Forest training in Google's YDF by fixing inefficiencies and introducing hierarchical SIMD-vectorized histogram filling and runtime-dynamic histograms, achieving up to 2-5x plus additional 1.6-2x speedups.
